start.title: Irish Pub in the Fleetenkieker, Hamburg
start.description: Irish pub on Börsenbrücke in Hamburg: 16 beers on tap, live sport on six screens, live music on Friday and Saturday, monthly pub quiz.
start.lead: Draught beer, football, rugby and live music in the middle of Hamburg's old town. Come in, we'll soon know you by name.
welcome: The Irish Pub in the Fleetenkieker brings Irish pub culture to the heart of Hamburg. In Ireland the pub is where friends and neighbours meet and are greeted by name. That is how we do it here too.
Expect ceol agus craic: music and good company. At the bar, before the match or at the quiz.

ueber-uns.title: About us | Irish Pub in the Fleetenkieker
ueber-uns.description: The Irish Pub in the Fleetenkieker brings Irish pub culture to Börsenbrücke in Hamburg. Who we are and how we do things.
ueber-uns.lead: Céad míle fáilte. A hundred thousand welcomes.
text: The Irish Pub in the Fleetenkieker sits in the heart of Hamburg, on Börsenbrücke. We bring Irish pub culture to the city.
In Ireland, friends and neighbours meet at the pub and are greeted by name. That is how we want it here too: ceol agus craic, music and good company.
ueber-uns.name: In Hamburg, a Fleetenkieker was one of the men who patrolled the Fleete, the city's canals, by boat. Fleet is the northern German word for a navigable canal.
ueber-uns.team: Fleetenkieker Irish Pub UG, managing director Glenn Stockdale.
ueber-uns.house: The pub is on Börsenbrücke in the old town, a few steps from the town hall. Neighbours drop in after work, fans come for the match and guests arrive from all over the world. At the bar you sit side by side, and it rarely takes long before you get talking.

datenschutz.title: Privacy | Irish Pub in the Fleetenkieker
datenschutz.description: Privacy policy of the Irish Pub in the Fleetenkieker (draft).

sections.title: Controller
sections.text: The controller for data processing on this website is Fleetenkieker Irish Pub UG, Börsenbrücke 10, 20457 Hamburg, represented by its managing director Glenn Stockdale. Phone +49 40 36093599, email info@irishpub-fleetenkieker.de.

sections.title: Server log files
sections.text: When you visit this website, our hosting provider automatically stores technical data sent by your browser: IP address, date and time, page requested, referrer, browser type and operating system. We need this data to run the website securely and reliably. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. The data is deleted after a short time and not combined with other data.

sections.title: Fonts
sections.text: All fonts on this website are stored on our own server. No connection to Google Fonts or other font providers is made when you visit a page.

sections.title: Google Maps
sections.text: On the contact page we embed a map from Google Maps, a service of Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. The map only loads after you click “Load map”. Only then is data such as your IP address sent to Google, possibly also to the USA. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR, given by the click. Without a click, no data goes to Google.

sections.title: Contact by email and phone
sections.text: If you call or write to us, for example to book a table or sign up for the pub quiz, we only process your details to handle your request. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR. We delete the data once it is no longer needed and no statutory retention obligations apply.

sections.title: Facebook and Instagram
sections.text: We link to our pages on Facebook and Instagram. No plugins from these services are embedded on this website. Data is only transferred once you follow a link. The privacy policy of Meta Platforms Ireland Limited then applies.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing of your data, to data portability and to object to processing. You can withdraw any consent at any time with effect for the future. Just send us an email.

sections.title: Right to lodge a complaint
sections.text: You can lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The authority responsible for us is the Hamburg Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information, Ludwig-Erhard-Straße 22, 20459 Hamburg.
